en: Color image of a busy harbor with large ships docked at a pier. Two huge bows of ocean-going vessels dominate the left and right foreground, with heavy chains and mooring lines stretching across the scene. The ship on the right bears a prominent red star on its bow, indicating a Soviet vessel. In the middle distance are cranes, cargo ships, and a white passenger liner. People in mid‑20th‑century clothing stand along the quay observing the ships under a bright blue sky with scattered clouds.
